highlights.title: US and Iran trade strikes for first time in weeks
highlights.summary: Iran says the attack on Larak Island, the first known US strikes since late July, killed two people and injured two others.

highlights.title: Novo telescópio da Nasa, Roman pode fazer em um mês o que o Hubble levaria um século
